trigger.description: ee curate apply or ee curate tombstone was asked to tombstone a memory that the G9 bipartite-authority graph marks as load-bearing (it is cited by one or more rules in the rule-provenance graph). Without --allow-tombstone-load-bearing the mutation is blocked so the operator must consciously override the protection.
setup_commands: # seed a memory and at least one rule that cites it via rule_provenance
ee curate validate --workspace . --json  # surface load-bearing candidates
